import cv2
import numpy as np
import math

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0095.png')
# Frame 94 was (0.949, 2.823, heading 90)
# Frame 95 turned -90 -> heading 0 deg (+y), moved 0.5 along +y:
# cam_x = 0.949, cam_y = 3.323, heading = 0.0 deg.
cam_x, cam_y, theta_deg = 0.949, 3.323, 0.0
theta_rad = math.radians(theta_deg)

# Stool legs in obs_0095:
# Let's find dark grey legs
mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 110) & (img[:, :, 1] > 70) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 2] < 110)
pts = np.argwhere(mask)
pts_stool = pts[(pts[:, 1] > 350) & (pts[:, 1] < 450) & (pts[:, 0] > 320)]
legs = []
for u_min, u_max in [(360, 385), (385, 410), (415, 445)]:
    sub = pts_stool[(pts_stool[:, 1] >= u_min) & (pts_stool[:, 1] <= u_max)]
    if len(sub) > 0:
        v_bot = np.max(sub[:, 0])
        u_c = np.mean(sub[sub[:, 0] == v_bot, 1])
        Z_c = 1.55 / ((v_bot - 256.0) / 256.0)
        X_c = ((u_c - 256.0) / 256.0) * Z_c
        # For heading 0 deg: Forward is +y, Right is +x
        wx = cam_x + X_c
        wy = cam_y + Z_c
        legs.append((wx, wy))
        print(f'Stool leg u={u_c:.1f}, v={v_bot}: world=({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f})')

if legs:
    print('Stool visible legs mean:', np.mean([l[0] for l in legs]), np.mean([l[1] for l in legs]))
"
